theorems.name: Submission.bf_cone_subset_iUnion_slabCones
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 0 < ℓ → ∀ W : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ)), finrank ℝ W = n → ∀ u : Fin ℓ → Rn (n + ℓ), Orthonormal ℝ u → (∀ j, u j ∈ Wᗮ) → ∀ (y : Rn (n + ℓ)) (s : ℝ), ‖W.starProjection y‖ < s * ‖y‖ → ∃ j, ‖W.starProjection y‖ < Real.sqrt (ℓ : ℝ) * s * ‖W.starProjection y + inner ℝ y (u j) • u j‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
